**.off-scale: A rule new on this site: its hand-tuned rem spacing reports without failing while it moves to Tailwind's spacing steps.
**.doubled-line: A rule new on this site: it reports without failing while its first findings are fixed (ourostack/ouro-ui#3257).
**.count-badge: A rule new on this site: it reports without failing while its first findings are fixed (ourostack/ouro-ui#3257).
**.pointer-not-control: A rule new on this site: it reports without failing while its first findings are fixed (ourostack/ouro-ui#3257).
**.near-miss: A rule new on this site: it reports without failing while its first findings are fixed (#3286).

/docs/patterns/.failed-request: The pattern previews are frames of Storybook, which Pages serves at /storybook/ beside the site; the check serves only the site's build, so each frame's address answers 404 here and 200 on the live site. A renamed or removed story is caught by the site test that points each preview at a story that exists (site/src/site.test.tsx).

/docs/message/.nested-frame: The squircle radii are 1.5 times larger, so the message demo's quote block, a small block inside a large bubble, nests at 23px by the rule; its radius stays small and the quote bar is a 4px pill.

/docs/model-interviews/.lone-word: The interview tables quote each model's own picks and pairings from the run records, which can't be reworded; at a phone's width a long list's last name can wrap alone even with text-wrap: pretty.

off-theme: .stage-window sets box-shadow: oklab(0 none none / 0.35) 0px 10px 14px -12px, a fixed shadow
[data-theme="pearl"] .stage-crew sets box-shadow: oklab(1 0 5.96046e-8 / 0.55) 0px 1px inset, a fixed shadow
[data-theme="pearl"] .stage-frame sets box-shadow: oklab(1 0 5.96046e-8 / 0.5) 0px 1px inset, a fixed shadow
[data-theme="pearl"].dark .stage-console, .dark[data-theme="pearl"] .stage-console sets box-shadow: oklab(0 none none / 0.6) 0px 28px 56px -28px, a fixed shadow
[data-theme="pearl"].dark .stage-crew, .dark[data-theme="pearl"] .stage-crew sets box-shadow: oklab(1 0 5.96046e-8 / 0.08) 0px 1px inset, a fixed shadow
